claude.fired: 9/9 steps with the skill table in AGENTS.md

notes: q01 is a sequential case on a runnable Laravel 13 shop: three fresh agents in turn add an admin overdue page, replace the synchronous CSV export with a queued emailed one, and fix the confirmation email's total. Every rule they need already has one home found by convention (the overdue scope, the total_with_vat_cents accessor, OrderPolicy::cancel, the admin gate, OrderStatus, config/billing.php). Both arms share a house-template AGENTS.md with the cleanup clause; the skill arm adds the skill table and installs the skill. Graded blind on the final tree against a rubric frozen before the first run, and checked by hand: no run in either arm re-derived VAT, an admin or ownership check, a status string or the overdue query, and every final tree passed php artisan test. Five of six runs kept OrdersExportController as the new job's trigger; the judge failed that once (a skill run) and passed it five times, so the arms are the same. The skill cost about 37% more tokens. Like the C# case, the base is small and clean enough that the model finds every home unaided; a case at the scale where duplication arises is still unmeasured. Composer ran with its home and cache in scratch; the fixture's composer.lock has package author fields removed.
